about: I'm a Game Design & Development student at Macromedia University in Cologne with a background in IT. Before my studies I trained as an IT specialist for systems integration (Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) and worked in IT support.

That background shapes how I make games. I enjoy the technical backbone – gameplay systems, tools, clean pipelines from Blender to the engine – and the problem-solving that comes with it. Alongside my studies I work as a working student in Enterprise Architecture Management at CONET.

What drives me is the moment a system clicks: when the code, the art pipeline and the design come together into something that simply feels right to play. I want to keep building exactly that – on teams where technical and creative people work side by side.
